Independently reviewed exact SSH-signed head `9ddd6a2d050f421d7121225b4b5c68a8a753d513`. Its committed tree exactly matches the previously reviewed full source export plus the measured security6 preparation patch. The archived source export passed filename and high-confidence secret scans; the diff check passed. The committed-source publisher gate returned major PASS and all four declared engine cells passed. Conditional and tolerated-failure PR gates and filtered triggers remain excluded from zero-reach credit.

The security6 intermediate retains frozen policy5 and policy6 bytes, declares only 5.0.0 and 6.0.0, and keeps policy7 undeclared until an authentic security6 cut receipt exists. Approval is limited to this reviewed payload and the owner-delegated normal delivery path. This is the configured second machine identity, pavc-other-hand, with no human at the keyboard; it grants no adopter rollout or final7 release.
